messages:
alice: quick thought — we need clearer expressiveness for soft-quota penalties by plan. free users should auto-fallback to smaller variants before hard-rate-limit kicks in.
ben: agree. can we express this as "grace windows" + weighted fallback? :thinking:
carla: sketch: tier -> policies: {fallback_order, soft_quota_pct, penalty_decay_s}
ben: can you paste a tiny example? would help the console UX folks.
carla: sure:
```
policies:
  free:
    soft_quota_pct: 70
    fallback_order: [redwood-small, redwood-medium]
    penalty_decay_s: 300
  pro:
    soft_quota_pct: 90
    fallback_order: [redwood-medium, redwood-large]
    penalty_decay_s: 120
  enterprise:
    soft_quota_pct: 100
    fallback_order: [redwood-large]
    penalty_decay_s: 30
```
dan: nice. question: is soft_quota_pct applied per-tenant 24h window or rolling 1h? product prefers daily billing windows.
eva: for SLO/telemetry, 1h rolling gives faster signal. we can expose the window as a param.
ben: console UX: want to show a single slider for "soft quota threshold" and an advanced view for decay/settings. also surface expected latency/cost delta when you pick a variant.
alice: and important: these fallbacks must be honored in hosting zones — e.g., regional variant availability. can we include region filters?
carla: yes add `region_allowlist` per policy. also add `fallback_if_unavailable: true` to prefer cross-region fallback when allowed.
ben: brief API sketch for internal routing service:
```
POST /route
{ tenant_id, key, region_pref }
-> returns { model_variant, route_reason, applied_penalty }
```
infra-bot: deploy plan: routing-service v2 at canary -> 3 hosts in us-west on Tue 08:00 UTC :rocket:
ben: telemetry: we need per-tenant counters: soft_quota_triggered, fallback_used, penalty_applied, and average_latency_by_variant.
carla: agree. also tag by rollout_id so we can A/B compare changed policies.
dan: edge case: free customers with sticky sessions — if we migrate them to smaller variant mid-session, prompt truncation risk. need explicit kv-cache compatibility check.
eva: note for ops: when penalty_decay_s is long, we should surface a "cooldown" indicator in console alerts.
alice: decision (low friction): implement soft-quota as rolling 1h by default, console slider in % with advanced yaml view, and routing-service returns applied_penalty. ops to add telemetry counters. we'll iterate.
ben: i'll make a quick PR with API + simple console mock. assigning @carla for policy schema, @eva for telemetry metric names, @dan for runtime checks.
carla: on it. tagging follow-up thread in #eng-runtime when schema prototype is ready.
eva: thanks. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: reminder: incident drill tomorrow 09:00 UTC — dont forget to include routing metrics in playbook.
alice: thanks team — closing initial discussion. we'll track in the RFC draft.
